author: potuz
content: I agree, but all I'm pointing is that benches need to be clear on what we're benching for. Derek's numbers above aren't compatible with what the benching team told me for Glamsterdam

author: potuz
content: Also regarding the BAL, for the purposes of that deadline it's irrelevant if it comes separated or not. We still have the same time to propagate both. The separation of the BAL serves mostly  to allow IL includers to have the post state before they've executed the payload and so can produce fresh ILs instead of duplicated bandwidth. I'm personally anyway working under the assumption that FOCIL doesn't ship in the first PQ fork as obviously incompatible
